title: THE KIT ON THE MAP SELECT SCREEN
why: His word: the kit should be part of the map select screen, not a separate later screen. The map select screen now has a KIT row of four under the weather row, in the same style: MY LOADOUT, FREEBIE KIT, RANDOM KIT and BEST KIT, each with its caps detail under it (RANDOM KIT is 2 GUNS and 1 EACH, BEST KIT is 3 GUNS and UP TO 3 EACH). One is on at a time, the last one is kept in your save, and an old save starts on MY LOADOUT. ASCEND TO THIS SECTOR applies the kit you picked and goes straight up, so the loadout card no longer comes after the map select. The staging screen ASCEND now opens the map select screen, so every route up ends there. The lift quick ascent still skips the page, and takes your kept kit if it is not MY LOADOUT. A party mate still gets the card for his own kit, with the same auto-ascend timer. RANDOM FROM STASH is now RANDOM KIT and TOP GEAR is now BEST KIT everywhere. This build changes the names and the screen; the guns and items each kit gives are the next builds.
now: The kit is a row on the map select screen: MY LOADOUT, FREEBIE KIT, RANDOM KIT, BEST KIT.
